post.description: Authenticate with username (or email) and password using the OAuth2 password flow (``application/x-www-form-urlencoded`` body). On success, returns a short-lived **access token** (15 min) in the response body and sets a long-lived **refresh token** (7 days) as an httpOnly Secure ``refresh_token`` cookie. Pass the access token in subsequent requests as ``Authorization: Bearer <token>``.

Exchange the long-lived ``refresh_token`` httpOnly cookie for a new short-lived access token and a rotated refresh token. The cookie must have been set by a previous call to ``POST /auth/token``. The refresh token is rotated on each call — the old token is invalidated and a new one is issued in its place.

post.summary: Logout — Clear the Refresh Token Cookie
post.description: Invalidate all refresh tokens for the authenticated user and clear the ``refresh_token`` httpOnly cookie, effectively logging the user out of any device that relies on this cookie for re-authentication. delete.description:
Delete an execution. Behaviour depends on ``origin``:

- ``imported|merged|split``: soft-delete (``deleted=true``), returns 200 with execution body. BRT link is preserved so re-import cannot resurrect it.
- ``manual``: hard-delete (row removed), returns 204 No Content.
- Already deleted: returns 409 Conflict.

The parent trade is re-aggregated after every delete.

get.description:
Compute and return the full performance metrics summary for the authenticated user's closed trades.

**What is computed:**
- Aggregate statistics: win rate, loss rate, profit factor, expectancy, Sharpe ratio, average win/loss, gross profit/loss, consecutive win/loss streaks, and average trade duration.
- Equity curve: cumulative PnL from `starting_capital`, one point per closed trade, capped at 1 000 entries.
- Drawdown curve: per-trade fractional and absolute drawdown from the running equity peak.
- `max_drawdown` and `max_drawdown_abs`: the worst drawdown observed over the entire period.

**Date filtering:** when `from_dt` or `to_dt` are supplied, only trades whose `closed_at` falls within the range (both bounds inclusive) are included. Omitting both returns all-time data.

**Authentication:** a valid Bearer token is required. Returns HTTP 401 if the token is missing, expired, or invalid.

get.description:
Return the drawdown time series for the authenticated user's closed trades, sorted by `closed_at` ascending.

**What each point contains:**
- `timestamp`: the `closed_at` datetime of the trade.
- `drawdown`: fractional drawdown from the running equity peak (0.0 to -1.0). For example, `-0.15` means the portfolio is 15 % below its peak at that moment.
- `drawdown_abs`: absolute drawdown in account currency (always ≤ 0).

**Peak initialisation:** the equity peak is seeded with `starting_capital`. If `starting_capital` is 0 (default), the peak starts at 0 and rises with each winning trade.

**Cap:** the underlying equity curve is capped at 1 000 points before the drawdown is computed, so the drawdown series also has at most 1 000 entries.

**Date filtering:** `from_dt` and `to_dt` (both inclusive) narrow the set of trades by `closed_at`. Omitting both returns all-time data.

**Authentication:** a valid Bearer token is required. Returns HTTP 401 if the token is missing, expired, or invalid.

TaxAnnualSummary.title: TaxAnnualSummary
TaxAnnualSummary.description:
Annual tax summary for German Anlage KAP reporting.

Splits realised P&L in EUR into two §20 EStG categories:

- **equities**: §20 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 EStG — ``AssetClass.EQUITY`` trades.
- **derivatives**: §20 Abs. 2 Nr. 3 EStG — all other asset classes
  (``OPTION``, ``FUTURE``, ``FOREX``, ``CRYPTO``).

Attributes:
    year: Calendar year this summary covers.
    equities: P&L block for equity (stock) trades.
    derivatives: P&L block for derivatives / other instruments.
    total_net_eur: Combined net P&L across both categories.
    trades_missing_eur: Number of closed trades in this year where
        ``pnl_eur`` is NULL (could not be converted to EUR).
    dividends_eur: Total dividends in EUR across all accounts.
    withholding_tax_eur: Total withholding tax in EUR across all accounts.
    interest_eur: Total interest income in EUR across all accounts.

gains_eur.title: Gains Eur
gains_eur.description: Total realised gains in EUR for this category (sum of positive pnl_eur). Always >= 0.

losses_eur.title: Losses Eur
losses_eur.description: Total realised losses in EUR for this category (sum of negative pnl_eur). Always <= 0.

net_eur.title: Net Eur
net_eur.description: Net P&L in EUR for this category (gains_eur + losses_eur).

trade_count.title: Trade Count
trade_count.description: Number of closed trades with a known pnl_eur in this category.

TaxCategoryBlock.title: TaxCategoryBlock
TaxCategoryBlock.description:
P&L summary for one §20 EStG tax category (equities or derivatives).

Attributes:
    gains_eur: Sum of all positive ``pnl_eur`` values in this category.
    losses_eur: Sum of all negative ``pnl_eur`` values in this category
        (always <= 0).
    net_eur: ``gains_eur + losses_eur`` — the net result for this category.
    trade_count: Number of closed trades with a non-null ``pnl_eur`` in
        this category.
